messages:
alex: FYI vendor (Zenith) just emailed — they can move 20 H200 units into the EU pool but only on an "airgap" manifest. customs paperwork might add 48-72h. need decision: accept split-air vs hold for full pallet.
priya: thanks alex. do we know which warehouses are affected? will those units map to the reserved pool or the marketplace?
alex: warehouse FRA-staging only for this wave. vendor says they can do single AWB: `AWB: 125-890-7723` or split into 4 smaller AWBs for faster handoff.
mateo: small AWBs reduce dock queue time but increase brokerage fees. estimated extra EUR 420 total for splits.
erin: if we split, can we tag units as RMA-priority so CS gets notified? we have 3 urgent RMA tickets waiting for replacements.
ops-bot: New RMA ticket created: #RMA-4721 (linked to customer ticket RT-9932). Assigned to @erin.
priya: vendor lead time note — their PO says ETA to FRA 2026-05-12, but customs delay could push handoff to 2026-05-15. also vendor requests we absorb insurance surcharge if we want prioritized loading.
alex: cost tradeoff: absorb surcharge (~EUR 900) and get units to customers faster vs save cost and accept 3–5 day delay. which do we prioritize for Dedicated customers?
mateo: for Dedicated contracts with SLA, we should pay. for general marketplace credits, we can route from FRA pool once cleared. need PO amendment for the surcharge.
erin: can we route 8 units for SLAs and 12 to FRA pool? vendor can partial-split but needs serial list to pre-fill customs forms. they asked for `serials.csv` by EOD.
alex: I'll pull serials from the provisioning queue. @mateo can you confirm which serials map to SLA customers?
mateo: on it. sending secure link in a sec. also flag: firmware mismatch on 2 units reported — vendor asked if they should ship as-is or hold for depot flash. decision affects RMA turnaround.
priya: ship as-is if depot can flash on receive. otherwise we'll lose another 48h. depot has limited slots next week. recommend ship-as-is and create flashing job ticket.
erin: agree ship-as-is and mark those 2 as 'flashing-required' in the RMA metadata so SRE automation picks them up.
alex: perfect. i'll confirm split AWBs + send `serials.csv` and PO amendment for surcharge. vendor asked for payment term acceptance (NET30) and route code `ZEN-EU-AIR`.
ops-bot: Deploy note: provisioning pipeline will generate preflight labels once `serials.csv` is uploaded to /procure/airgap/ (internal). Link: https://redwood.internal/procure/airgap-playbook
mateo: uploaded serials to the secure bucket and DM'd the vendor contact. included notes about 2 flashing units and SLA mapping.
priya: trackers: AWB `125-890-7723` (master) + splits `125-890-7723-01..-04`. customs HS code we used: `8471.80` — finance approved tariff reclass for this shipment.
erin: thanks everyone. action items: alex — PO amendment + send serials; mateo — confirm SLA serials (done); priya — confirm surcharge approval for Dedicated customers; ops-bot — create flashing tickets for two serials once received.
alex: will update here when vendor confirms loading and ETA. :thumbsup:
